intro: Lakeview Cascadia is an HDB BTO project in Bishan. It was launched on 16 June 2026, and our project file records 1,221 flats, from HDB’s June 2026 BTO announcement. That official confirmation covers the launch and the recorded unit count only. Completion and key dates are unconfirmed and, in our file, generally beyond 2027. Tenure is left blank. The name “Lakeview” is not treated here as a confirmed outlook; we will not assign a reservoir or park view to your future stack. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Lakeview Cascadia renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Lakeview Cascadia interior
sections.text:
Bishan is a mature, well-connected central-north town, which is why many buyers plan this as a long stay. You still have time, and you should use it. Once HDB issues your approved plan, the interior brief that usually pays off is built-in: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, with a built-in desk in a common bedroom if that room will be a study. Maison is an interior designer. We specify carpentry, not IKEA-style loose furniture, and we can work in a wide room view or in closer shots of a kitchen run or a wardrobe.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed. Bishan Ridges is another Bishan page in this batch, at a different and unconfirmed stage; do not use it as a completion guide for Lakeview Cascadia. Thomson Reserve and AMO Residence sit in the wider District 20 catchment and are nearby links only. We will not invent walking times to Bishan town, to a reservoir, or to any MRT station.

After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before any carpentry is fabricated. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison when you have your official plan. We are not affiliated with HDB.
